Plastic Bearings

  • More expensive than ordinary bearings
  • No need to add lubricant
  • Light weight
  • Low rotational noise

 

Ideal Applications for plastic bearings

  • When contact with food or the avoidance of mineral lubricating oils is required
  • Light load and mass reduction is desired
  • Desire to minimize rotational noise
  • Exposure to factors that accelerate steel corrosion, such as water
